create_compound_skill: create a CompoundSkill instance that executes a sequence of SkillPolicy skills in order
get_low_level_action: get the low-level action from the currently active skill in the compound skill sequence
set_target: set the target for all skills in the compound skill instance across the environment
reset_compound_skill: reset the compound skill and all sub-skills to their initial state for a new batch
is_skill_done: check if the compound skill sequence has completed execution for a given batch index
